versions.content: Values of the individual DiagnosticStorageCondition s The values of the individual DiagnosticStorageCondition s need to be algorith- mically evaluated in order to find out whether or not the storage of the Diagnos- ticEvent is permitted. The algorithm that is supposed to be implemented for this purpose is documented in [SWS_Dem_00459].
